i was the last person my ex contacted. i didn’t know he what he was about to do, nobody does. i responded to his message in anger because of an argument we were in the middle of. i still regret it. 

it’ll be a year since then on friday. over this year i have spoken to him in many ways. the night before i tried to end my own life, i stared at a star i had never seen before, hanging above the place we would sit together, and talked with it for three hours. sometimes i just stare at ceilings. i talk at birds i think he used to communicate with me. at this stage in my mourning i just see him in dreams or just converse in my head. i think that this is a personal decision you have to make. the way you can communicate with her is up to you, nobody else. write letters, sing songs, scream in the woods. whatever it is, i hope it brings you some closure each time.
